scope: lab-only Hazel predictions and local file snapshot (no Git commit)
year_convention: First formal public launch year of the represented processor generation; inherited from Section 8.1
ice_lake_year_note: Use generation-wide 2020 for 3rd Generation Xeon Scalable, consistent with Section 8.1. Ice Lake-SP implementation launched in 2021; retain both dates and calculate coordinate sensitivity.
uncertainty_policy: Descriptive envelopes and lab-only sensitivity; no nominal confidence or coverage probability
model_selection_note: Exploratory models selected after inspecting the lab data. Model choice and all parameters are frozen before Hazel experiments.
